quotes.claim: Default zero-infinity dispatches the CPU launcher; zero-infinity-nvme is a distinct optional dispatch.
The all branch does not execute the commented NVMe invocation.
An NVMe optimizer template exists, while parameter offload remains CPU; this is not a saved NVMe runtime record.
AIO template uses 1 MiB block/queue16/thread2, without actual run H or byte evidence.
Optional launcher selects the NVMe JSON and model positional arguments.
A tee destination in a launcher is not the contents of a saved execution log.
A separate both-NVMe config uses /nvme_data; the inspected optional launcher does not select it, and no saved run is associated.
The paper explicitly says the default comparison uses CPU RAM; its NVMe comparison is separately described.
quotes.text: By default, we compare STRONGHOLD against ZeRO-Infinity with CPU RAM instead of using NVMe
